stem.text: A ball is dropped onto horizontal ground and bounces vertically upwards. When the ball is in contact with the ground, the following forces act:

items: the contact force $P$ exerted on the ground by the ball
the contact force $N$ exerted on the ball by the ground.

stem.alt: Diagram of a ball resting on a ground surface, with arrows at the contact point labelled W pointing downwards, N pointing upwards and P pointing downwards; labels ball and ground.

stem.text: When the ball is in contact with the ground, the ball is momentarily stationary.
At this instant, which relationship is correct?
